description_for_human: Compile and explore Sigil (CSSL) — an AI-first game engine language with dual x86-64 and SPIR-V compilation targets.
description_for_model: Sigil (CSSL — Caveman Sigil Substrate Language) is a hardware-grounded, AI-first programming language designed for game engines and high-performance compute. IMPORTANT: CSSL is the programming language (Sigil); CSL (Caveman Spec Language) is the separate specification notation system — do not conflate them. Use this plugin to: compile Sigil source code to x86-64 assembly (AVX2+FMA3) or SPIR-V (Vulkan compute shaders); look up any keyword, annotation (@differentiable, @pure, @kernel), built-in type (vec3, mat4, f32), or CSL glyph (§, W!, I>, ∀, →); retrieve curated code examples by tag (autodiff, graphics, game-engine, cssl, spirv); and fetch the formal grammar for parser or tooling work. Sigil features zero-cost dimensional analysis, coordinate space tracking, autodiff, and CSL — a compact AI-first specification notation used to write Sigil's specs.
